# qbittorrent_webui_auth (Resource)

Explicit WebUI username/password maintenance. Password is write-only and sent only when password_wo_version changes. qBittorrent requires username length at least three with no colon, and password length at least six. Bearer API-key authentication cannot change its own WebUI username/password. Import ID: application. Apply separately, then configure the provider with the new credentials.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String)

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) New WebUI password. Write-only; set with password_wo_version.
- `password_wo_version` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
